cases.input: A Python static analyzer crashes at assignment-value inspection on module-level __all__, = (...) with an AST Tuple lacking value.
cases.reason: The public symptom matches the supported dispatch boundary.

cases.input: An internal error allegedly involves __all__, but no source snippet, traceback or pinned checkout is supplied.
cases.reason: Request public context and authorize inspection only until the semantic boundary is known.

cases.input: Executing Python raises ValueError because a one-name tuple target receives two values.
cases.reason: Runtime unpacking is not the supported static-analysis defect.

cases.input: A directly assigned __all__ list produces an undefined-name diagnostic without an internal error.
cases.reason: No indirect-target dispatch mismatch is established.
